verdict.rationale: Canva ships official SDK/API surfaces for AI-native development: Apps SDK, Connect APIs with OpenAPI spec for client SDK generation, an official CLI (verified running keylessly via npx), and a hosted MCP server (verified live, OAuth-gated) exposing design generation/editing/export as tools. missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials building against these SDKs, and the OpenAPI spec itself wasn't discoverable at expected public paths (404s on canva.dev/openapi.json etc.), suggesting docs-only confirmation rather than fully open spec access.
